prompts.plate: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production environment base plate for a portrait hand-painted game, not a finished interface. Edit target: the attached approved photo-wall design. Preserve the exact portrait composition, rich handmade painted-paper textures, warm beige plaster wall, climbing green vines and small five-petal white flowers around the top and sides, low rustic wood wall trim, lower wooden plank floor, and the single braided straw mat at lower left where the fish currently rests. Remove completely ALL six photographs and paper frames, ALL photo ropes, ALL clips, ALL writing, all plaques, signs, buttons, badges, hanging chains, labels, characters/fish, stacked papers, and UI. Reconstruct the warm plaster wall cleanly behind removed objects; keep this broad upper-middle wall calm and open for independently rendered photographs later. The straw mat must be empty, and right/lower floor must be clean enough for dynamic paper stack and two draggable clips later. No window anywhere. Lighting: neutral, softly and evenly diffuse warm material colors; remove baked strong directional sunlight, light shafts, lens bloom and hard cast shadows; only restrained intrinsic texture and ambient crevice shading. Keep original foliage framing, floor perspective, straw weaving, painterly edges and material richness. Do not redesign as a different scene. Output only this clean background, at approximately 1080 x 1920 pixels, portrait 9:16. No border, no text, no watermark.
prompts.clip: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: one separate game sprite on true transparent background. Using the attached approved photo-wall art as the exact style and object reference, recreate only ONE of the large wooden spring clothespins seen on the bottom floor, without its hanging round tag. Render one real, complete functional wooden clothespin with two warm honey-brown wooden jaws and a small dark metal coil spring, in the same soft hand-painted richly textured material style. Three-quarter top view, diagonal from lower-left to upper-right, broad enough to remain legible at about 128 x 96 logical pixels. Keep the wood grain, bevels, clean dark painted outline and correct two-jaw structure. Absolutely no floor, mat, scenery, round tag, loop, string, text, photo, extra objects or frame. No cast shadow or glow beyond object silhouette; only intrinsic mild ambient material shading, no baked directional strong shine. Sprite object occupies about 85% of a landscape canvas around 512 x 384 pixels. Background genuinely transparent, preserve clean natural antialiased alpha around the clip.
prompts.frame: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: standalone portrait paper-photo-frame texture for a hand-painted game. Using the attached photo-wall design as material/style reference, recreate ONE straight, unrotated ivory paper photo frame matching its warm off-white fibrous paper borders. The outside is a simple portrait rectangle with very subtly irregular worn edges; paper is flat and front-facing with no perspective, no rolled corners, no directional shadows and no three-dimensional bending (those will be animated at runtime). Fine paper fibers and a few delicate old paper creases in the border, sparse warm parchment speckles. The inner portrait rectangular aperture must be completely TRANSPARENT, and the entire exterior outside the paper must also be genuinely TRANSPARENT. Border at left/right/top about 6% of outer width; bottom border about 17% of outer height so runtime stamps can sit there. No photo content, color fill inside the aperture, no writing, numbers, stamps, clip, rope, sign, flowers, light rays or backdrop. Exactly one frame, no alternatives or sprite sheet. Natural clean antialiased alpha, neutral diffuse intrinsic material appearance. Output approximately 512 x 640 pixels, portrait 4:5.
